reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Absolutely useless app. I enquired about costs and more  information from like 5 wedding venues and I didn’t get a single response.

reviews.title: Complicated
reviews.text: Needs simple links . It is more direct at booking the paying retailers/suplliers .

reviews.title: Temperamental
reviews.text:
The app is temperamental and runs very slow. It’s not very user friendly and feels
Clunky to navigate. The
Concept is good and when working as it should it would be a very useful app but more often than not, it malfunctions. I will be trying another comparable app.

reviews.title: Charging suppliers
reviews.text:
I found out that they are now charging suppliers so many of the good ones have disappeared now narrowing choices.. 
looking at Hitched now as it’s not as money grabbing

reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: Got half way through planning, needed an update, now no longer loads anything. Don’t bother unless you want to lose all that you have planned, disappointing.
